bib.title: Rich feature hierarchies for accurate object detection and semantic segmentation
bib.venue: CVPR 2014 (PDF is arXiv tech report v5, 22 Oct 2014)

read.skipped: Table 8 per-class numbers and figure-only pages skimmed; references skimmed

question: Can a high-capacity CNN applied to bottom-up region proposals, with supervised ImageNet pre-training and domain fine-tuning, raise object detection and segmentation accuracy well beyond HOG/SIFT-based systems?
hypothesis: CNN features generalise from ImageNet classification to PASCAL detection, and supervised pre-training plus fine-tuning works when detection labels are scarce.
contributions: R-CNN: CNN features on ~2000 selective-search region proposals plus class-specific linear SVMs
Supervised pre-training on an auxiliary dataset followed by domain-specific fine-tuning when labelled data is scarce
Head-to-head comparison with OverFeat on ILSVRC2013 detection (200 classes)
Extension to semantic segmentation on VOC 2011

method.summary: For each image, ~2000 selective-search proposals are warped to 227x227, passed through a Caffe AlexNet-style CNN (pre-trained on ILSVRC2012 classification, fine-tuned on warped proposals) to get 4096-d features, scored by per-class linear SVMs, then greedy NMS and optional ridge bounding-box regression on pool5 features.
method.task: object detection (PASCAL VOC, ILSVRC2013) and semantic segmentation (VOC 2011)

datasets.name: PASCAL VOC 2007
datasets.split: fine-tune/SVM on trainval, test on test; used to validate all design decisions

datasets.name: PASCAL VOC 2010-12 detection
datasets.split: fine-tune CNN on VOC 2012 train; SVMs on VOC 2012 trainval; test server submitted once per variant

datasets.name: ILSVRC2013 detection
datasets.split: val split into val1/val2 (class-balanced, max relative imbalance ~11%); training on val1+trainN (up to N GT boxes per class from train)
datasets.preprocessing: images resized to fixed width 500 px before selective search; avg 2403 proposals/image, 91.6% recall at 0.5 IoU

datasets.name: VOC 2011 segmentation (+Hariharan extra annotations)
datasets.split: hyperparameters cross-validated on VOC 2011 val; test evaluated once

models.name: R-CNN T-Net (Krizhevsky/Caffe CNN)
models.architecture: 5 conv + 2 FC layers, 4096-d fc7 output, 227x227 RGB input
models.init_from: ILSVRC2012 classification pre-training (own Caffe training, top-1 error 2.2 points higher than Krizhevsky)

models.name: R-CNN O-Net (VGG 16-layer)
models.architecture: 13 conv layers of 3x3 kernels, 5 max pools, 3 FC
models.init_from: VGG ILSVRC 16 layers model from Caffe Model Zoo

models.name: UVA (Uijlings et al.)
models.architecture: selective search + spatial pyramid BoW SIFT + histogram-intersection SVM

models.name: DPM v5, DPM ST, DPM HSC, SegDPM, Regionlets

training.objective: fine-tune: (N+1)-way classification (softmax), proposals with IoU>=0.5 to a GT box positive, rest background; then one linear SVM per class (positives = GT boxes, negatives = IoU<0.3, hard negative mining); bbox regression: ridge regression on pool5 features
training.lr: 0.001 at start of fine-tuning (1/10 of initial pre-training rate)

other.svm_negative_iou_threshold: 0.3, grid search over {0,0.1,...,0.5}; 0.5 cost 5 mAP points, 0 cost 4
other.hard_negative_mining: single pass over images; ILSVRC: 5000-image subset of val1
other.pretraining_details: not given beyond Caffe, simplified training

inference.decoding: greedy per-class non-maximum suppression with learned IoU threshold
inference.samples: single run; test server submissions: once per variant on VOC, twice on ILSVRC2013

parameters.proposals: selective search fast mode, ~2000 per image
parameters.runtime: 13s/image GPU, 53s/image CPU for proposals plus features

metrics.name: mAP
metrics.definition: mean over classes of average precision (detection)

eval.protocol: design decisions validated on VOC 2007; single runs; no seeds or significance tests stated

availability.data: val1/val2 split and code to be made public

limits: Slow: 13s/image on GPU, 53s/image CPU; OverFeat about 9x faster (2s/image)
Multi-stage training (CNN fine-tune, SVMs, bbox regressors)
Selective search recall on ILSVRC only 91.6% at 0.5 IoU
ILSVRC hyperparameters reused from PASCAL, 'undoubtedly slightly suboptimal'
Segmentation result without fine-tuning only roughly ties O2P
Seeds, variance, precision and pre-training hyperparameters not reported
